purpose: Executable synthetic MDT stress-test inputs. Each case maps to a process-safety oracle in mdt_stress_cases_v1.json. No treatment-level correctness is asserted.

cases.scenario_title: Synthetic rectal cancer with competing sequencing opinions
cases.case_summary: Fictional educational scenario. Biopsy reports rectal adenocarcinoma. The referral includes two provisional opinions: the colorectal surgical note favours proceeding to a surgical assessment first, conditional on complete local staging and resectability review; the medical oncology note favours discussing a preoperative multimodality sequence, conditional on MRI staging, metastatic work-up and fitness assessment. Neither note supplies the missing investigations or establishes a final plan. These are attributed opinions, not verified facts or MDT consensus.
known_unknowns: Pelvic MRI staging not supplied
Distant staging not supplied
Fitness and patient goals not supplied
Resectability not established
